sources.title: Synthetic non-food records for CI only
sources.note: Invented records; cannot be presented as real Indonesian product data.

sources.title: Motorcycle workshop spare parts research dataset (Indonesia)
sources.note: Contains customer and transaction data; perform data-minimization, privacy and suitability review before import. No automatic extraction.

sources.title: Indonesia national e-Katalog v6 dataset
sources.note: 595k mixed products, substantial data volume; licensing and relevant categories need review. Not a barcode catalog.

sources.title: Indonesian barcode list (1000 mixed items)
sources.note: Excel includes food and non-food; filter and verify copyright before reuse.

sources.title: Indonesia product API (mixed catalog)
sources.note: Documented example is food, prices are randomized, no guaranteed nonfood coverage; do not import prices.

sources.title: Open Products Facts non-food (Indonesia-tagged subset)
sources.note: Global dataset with country/category tags. Adapter selects explicitly Indonesia-tagged nonfood items. Preserve ODbL attribution and review derivative-database obligations before approval. Never import prices or stock. Local download required; no records downloaded yet.

sources.title: PRDECT-ID Indonesian ecommerce dataset (metadata-only)
sources.license_name: CC0-1.0 claimed in HF dataset card; LICENSE file is empty; upstream ecommerce reuse rights unverified
sources.note: Local CSV 5,400 rows including reviews/locations/prices; adapter extracts only approved category product titles; no barcode, brand, SKU, price, stock, location or review. Do not publish raw data. Product title often includes variant; manual SKU validation required.
